name: maasetu
description: MaaSetu — Because Every Mother Matters. Maternal healthcare platform monorepo (Next.js web app, NestJS API, shared contracts).

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:api
scripts.lint: cd apps/web && bun run lint && cd ../api && bun run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/web && bun run typecheck && cd ../api && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: cd apps/api && bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.db:push: echo "MaaSetu Phase 1: no local database. Data layer is Supabase-managed PostgreSQL (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Nothing to push."
